title: Financial transaction and consistency boundaries
workflow: Caller submits authorized command with stable idempotency key
Owning domain validates entity, permissions, lifecycle and effective rules
Accounting command checks balancing, account mapping and unique command identity
Atomic commit persists approved journal and outbox record
External consumers update read models with inbox deduplication
Independent reconciliation compares journal totals and source obligation
requirements: No two services may independently mutate the authoritative financial state
A posted journal is immutable; correction uses a new balanced journal and original reference
Each posting is exactly balanced per currency and legal entity in exact arithmetic
Unknown external results require investigation, never a blind repost or artificial success
Reporting projections have explicit freshness and source checkpoint markers
Regulatory PCEC 312/322 mapping remains disabled until competent authority resolves ambiguity
acceptance_cases: Reject journal with unequal debit and credit totals
Repeat identical command and verify one authoritative posting
Simulate commit-before-outbox-publication and verify eventual delivery
Replay a reversal and ensure no duplicate correction
approval_gate: Approved institution-specific chart mapping, CFO controls, reproducible financial tests and independently signed ledger invariants.
